hero.description: Image is part of an image sequence showing the deconstruction of Clouth-Gummiwerke in Cologne, Germany and the construction of the new Clout-Quarter in the same place. The image sequence spans a time of 6 years. The image show the Clouth-quarter from north-east end over the location of former gate 4.
